cases.crime: A velvet jewelry case vanished from the hotel safe deposit office.
cases.setting: The case unfolds inside the Grand Mariston Hotel, all hushed carpets, service corridors, and brass-caged lifts after midnight.
cases.brief: A velvet jewelry case disappeared from the safe deposit office of the Grand Mariston Hotel during the late-night lull. In a maze of carpeted corridors, shuttered lounges, and service passages, four members of the house account for the same hour.

suspects.name: The Curator
suspects.statement: Between eleven and midnight, I was at the Palm Court Bar behind the shuttered tea lounge with The Concierge. That is where I remained for the hour.
suspects.place: the palm court bar behind the shuttered tea lounge

suspects.name: The Setter
suspects.statement: Between eleven and midnight, I was in the linen storeroom off the third-floor service hall with The Quizmaster. I was there the whole time.
suspects.place: the linen storeroom off the third-floor service hall

suspects.name: The Quizmaster
suspects.statement: Between eleven and midnight, I was at the linen storeroom off the third-floor service hall. I was there with The Setter.
suspects.place: the linen storeroom off the third-floor service hall

suspects.name: The Concierge
suspects.statement: Between eleven and midnight, I was at the brass-caged lift outside the safe deposit office with The Curator. That is where I was, and that is who was with me.
suspects.place: the brass-caged lift outside the safe deposit office

cases.crime: A silver prop dagger vanished from the locked props cabinet.
cases.setting: An old theatre of red velvet, paint dust, rope lines, and cramped backstage passages just off the stage and under the flies.
cases.brief: During the hour before the house opened, a silver prop dagger disappeared from the props cabinet in an ageing theatre full of backstage nooks, draughty passages, and velvet shadows.

suspects.name: The Curator
suspects.statement: Between eight and nine, I was at the paint-splattered scene dock by the loading doors with The Smith. That is where I was, plainly, the whole hour.
suspects.place: the paint-splattered scene dock by the loading doors

suspects.name: The Quizmaster
suspects.statement: Between eight and nine, I was in the green room with its foxed mirrors and cold tea tray, with The Piano Teacher. That is where I was.
suspects.place: the green room with its foxed mirrors and cold tea tray

suspects.name: The Smith
suspects.statement: I was at the paint-splattered scene dock by the loading doors. I was with The Curator.
suspects.place: the paint-splattered scene dock by the loading doors

suspects.name: The Piano Teacher
suspects.statement: Between eight and nine, I was at the dim orchestra pit below the apron with The Quizmaster. I was there the whole time.
suspects.place: the dim orchestra pit below the apron

cases.crime: A small enameled reliquary vanished from a locked medieval gallery after closing.
cases.setting: The museum had gone dark for the night, with only work lights glowing in back corridors, conservation rooms, and the echoing galleries beyond the velvet ropes.
cases.brief: After closing, a small enameled reliquary disappeared from the medieval wing of a darkened museum. Four members of the house account for the same hour among conservation rooms, service spaces, and locked galleries.

suspects.name: The Curator
suspects.statement: Between nine and ten, I was in the textile conservation lab behind the Flemish tapestries with The Piano Teacher. That is where I was.
suspects.place: the textile conservation lab behind the Flemish tapestries

suspects.name: The Smith
suspects.statement: I was at the service lift vestibule by the crated Roman busts. I was with The Concierge.
suspects.place: the service lift vestibule by the crated Roman busts

suspects.name: The Concierge
suspects.statement: Between nine and ten, I was at the loading dock beside the rain-slick fire door with The Smith. That is where I was for that hour.
suspects.place: the loading dock beside the rain-slick fire door

suspects.name: The Piano Teacher
suspects.statement: Between nine and ten, I was in the textile conservation lab behind the Flemish tapestries with The Curator. I was there the whole hour.
suspects.place: the textile conservation lab behind the Flemish tapestries

cases.crime: A passenger's lacquered dispatch case vanished from the purser's office.
cases.setting: The case unfolds aboard a night ferry, with steel companionways, a wind-scoured outer deck, and cramped service rooms humming below the passenger lounges.
cases.brief: A lacquered dispatch case disappeared aboard a night ferry during the hour between nine and ten. The accounts come from the ferry's passages and lounges, from the purser's corridor to the wind-shielded promenade.

suspects.name: The Curator
suspects.statement: Between nine and ten, I was in the passage outside the map case by the purser’s office, with The Setter. That is where I was, plainly, and nowhere else.
suspects.place: the purser's office passage outside the map case

suspects.name: The Quizmaster
suspects.statement: Between nine and ten, I was at the aft observation lounge beneath the salt-fogged windows, with The Concierge. That is where I was, plainly stated.
suspects.place: the aft observation lounge beneath the salt-fogged windows

suspects.name: The Setter
suspects.statement: Between nine and ten, I was in the purser’s office passage outside the map case, with The Curator. That is where I was, plainly, and with company.
suspects.place: the purser's office passage outside the map case

suspects.name: The Concierge
suspects.statement: Between nine and ten, I was at the lee-side promenade by the lifebuoy racks with The Quizmaster. That is where I was, plainly and without ambiguity.
suspects.place: the lee-side promenade by the lifebuoy racks

cases.crime: A brass eyepiece from the main telescope has gone missing.
cases.setting: The matter unfolds in an old hilltop observatory, all echoing domes, red-lit stairwells, frost-rimmed catwalks, and instrument rooms smelling of oil and dust.
cases.brief: A brass eyepiece vanished from the hilltop observatory during the late watch, while the suspects placed themselves among the domes, archives, and narrow service rooms. Sort out who truly kept company with whom between eleven and midnight.

suspects.name: The Curator
suspects.statement: I was at the chart archive under the west dome between eleven and midnight, with The Piano Teacher. That is where I was, and that is the truth.
suspects.place: the chart archive under the west dome

suspects.name: The Smith
suspects.statement: Between eleven and midnight, I was at the copper-ladder well beneath the main telescope. The Concierge was with me.
suspects.place: the copper-ladder well beneath the main telescope

suspects.name: The Piano Teacher
suspects.statement: Between eleven and midnight, I was at the chart archive under the west dome with The Curator. I remained there the whole hour.
suspects.place: the chart archive under the west dome

suspects.name: The Concierge
suspects.statement: Between eleven and midnight, I was at the shuttered transit room overlooking the south slit with The Smith. That is where I was for that hour.
suspects.place: the shuttered transit room overlooking the south slit

cases.crime: A tin of saffron buns vanished from the cooling rack before dawn prep.
cases.setting: The case unfolds in Briar & Crust, a narrow old bakery with a flour-dusted basement mixer room, a tiled proving kitchen, a warm front shop behind the glass cases, and a cramped back alley by the delivery door.
cases.hour: between five and six in the morning
cases.brief: Before sunrise at Briar & Crust, a tray of saffron buns disappeared from the cooling rack. The hour in question runs through the front shop, the basement mixer room, and the alley by the delivery door.

suspects.name: The Curator
suspects.statement: Between five and six in the morning, I was at the front shop by the glass cases with The Piano Teacher. That is where I was, plainly.
suspects.place: the front shop by the glass cases

suspects.name: The Smith
suspects.statement: Between five and six in the morning, I was in the basement mixer room beside the old spiral dough hook. I was with The Concierge.
suspects.place: the basement mixer room beside the old spiral dough hook

suspects.name: The Concierge
suspects.statement: Between five and six in the morning, I was at the back alley by the delivery door with The Smith. That is where I was during the hour the tin of saffron buns went missing.
suspects.place: the back alley at the delivery door

suspects.name: The Piano Teacher
suspects.statement: Between five and six in the morning, I was at the front shop by the glass cases with The Curator. That is where I was, and that is who was with me.
suspects.place: the front shop by the glass cases
